script_text: Stop, Aquarius: the Aries Full Moon is cracking your communication axis now. Aquarius is fixed air, traditionally ruled by Saturn and modernly by Uranus. Saturn near 12° Pisces opposes 12° Aquarius and tightens the 7th House of commitments, while the Full Moon at 3° Aries opposes the 3° Libra Sun across the 3rd and 9th Houses. If single, seek someone older or steadier who can sustain a conversation; Saturn rewards patient interest, not impulsive declarations. If attached, name the recurring boundary or promise before it hardens into resentment. Your 3rd House of messages and negotiations is career-critical today: send that proposal, application, or salary request in writing, because the Full Moon’s 3rd-to-9th opposition can turn talk into a clear decision. Avoid overexplaining one unclear text; the Saturn opposition can magnify silence into doubt. Follow for tomorrow’s reading and planetary insight.
